content: The text discusses the relationship between the number of elements being sorted and the time it takes to complete the task. Explaining that larger quantities will naturally take longer to sort, it introduces the concept of parameterizing the input size to discuss time as a function of size. The text also emphasizes the importance of providing upper bounds for the running time, as a form of guarantee to the user of the maximum duration a program may take to run. It mentions that knowing a program won't exceed a certain running time is more useful than knowing it will run for at least a specific duration.
